# Q4 corpus: sources and licences

Fixtures for the Q4 experiment (formatting churn on save, see `docs/q4-diff-churn.md`). Downloaded files are
byte-for-byte copies of the upstream file (downloaded 2026-10-13); only the file name was changed. Constructed
files are generated by `node scripts/q4-make-fixtures.mjs`.

| File | Style | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
